prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady ascent along a snow-covered trail on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves forward, capturing the textured surface of the snow underfoot, with occasional patches of exposed rock and sparse vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding environment reveals a dense forest of snow-laden trees on the right, their branches heavy with white powder, while the left side opens up to a steep drop-off into a misty valley. The camera angle shifts slightly upward, offering a broader view of the hazy, overcast sky that casts a soft, diffused light over the landscape. The path continues to wind upwards, revealing more of the rugged terrain, with large boulders and rocky outcrops emerging from the snow. The camera pans to the right, showcasing a panoramic vista of distant mountain peaks shrouded in clouds, their majestic forms partially obscured by the fog. The scene transitions to a clearer section of the trail, where the sky brightens to a crisp blue, and the sunlight illuminates the pristine snow, casting sharp shadows. The camera then focuses on a small wooden structure nestled among the rocks, before continuing along the path, which narrows and becomes steeper, leading towards a rocky ridge with a lone tree standing resiliently against the wind. The overall atmosphere remains serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the isolation and natural beauty of the Mardi Himal Trail.
